variety_description: High yielding, early maturity, semi-dwarf, medium slender variety developed by TNAU, Coimbatore and released in 2015 for cultivation in irrigated lowland areas of Tamil Nadu. It has broad dark green leaves, and lengthy panicles of 23 to 28 cm with white fine grains. Tolerant to lodging and shattering. Tolerant to major diseases and insect pests.
